page_text:
June 17, 2019 

Via Filing, Messenger, and Email 

Ms. Denise McNerney  
Merits Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  Atlantic Christian Co. v. Christian, No. 17-1498 

Dear Ms. McNerney: 

We  represent,  respectively,    petitioner    and    respondents    in    the    above  
referenced  matter.  We  jointly  write  to  you    to    request    extension    of    times    on    the 
merits  briefs  and  joint  appendix  in  this  case    if    the    case    is    scheduled    for    oral 
argument in December. We request the following  deadlines: 

Brief of petitioner (and joint appendix): 
Brief of respondents; 
Reply brief of petitioner: 

August 21, 2019 
October 15, 2019 
November 20, 2019 

Both parties have agreed to the foregoing schedule, which would enable this case to 
be  heard  during  the  Court's  December  2019  sitting.  Respectfully,  we  think  the 
requested  extension  is  appropriate  given  the  features  of  this  case,  which  has  three 
questions  presented.  It  also  arises  from  proceedings  in    the    trial    court    that 
generated  an  extensive  record.  An  August  deadline  for  filing  the  joint  appendix,  in 
particular, will best allow the parties to identify  the portions of  the record  that  will 
benefit the Court in considering the case. 

Should you need any additional information from us, please do not hesitate to 

let us know. 

Yours sincerely, 

/s/ Lisa S. Blatt  

Lisa S. Blatt, Counsel for Petitioner 

Joseph R. Palmore, Counsel for 
Respondents
